title: Bender
author: Colleen Boye
description:
Sticky blood is soaking through your shirt. You’ll die out here without help. Gun or no gun, you’re going to have to get to Gray’s Jeep before him if you want to survive.

You have one advantage over Gray. This is your home. You’ve already marked many of the walls, and you can bend them. All you have to do is make the path to the Jeep longer for him and shorter for you.

(This was an entry to IntroComp, and is thus incomplete.)
